name: Hotel Park
beschreibung: Hotel Park enjoys a peaceful side-street location close to the town centre of St. Johann in Tirol. The property harmoniously combines alpine tradition with contemporary design. Rooms are comfortably appointed with private balconies and complimentary Wi-Fi. In the wellness area, guests find a sauna, steam bath, and relaxation lounge. Summer brings mountain biking and hiking across the Kitzbühel Alps, while winter offers seamless access to premier ski resorts.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Park in St. Johann in Tirol features a quiet central setting, a sauna and steam wellness area, regional dining, and easy access to Kitzbühel Alps slopes.
